events.description: HACKSPHERE 2.0 was a collaborative hackathon with two rounds: an online Ideathon, followed by an onsite hackathon for the top teams. Over 800+ people and 279 teams participated. Top teams competed for the price pool of ₹15,000.
The Carnival Carousel was a 3-day fun-filled ride with quick and exciting games in Sikke Di Hera Pheri, brain crushing coding puzzles in Decode Junction and finally Catch the Flag in Khul ja sim sim.
FizzBuzz 2.0 a wave of enjoyment, encourages teamwork, logic-building, through friendly competition. With nearly 100+ team registrations, and a price-pool of ₹6000!
